hero.body: Pandie Fɔndeshɔn de stɔp di gap fɔ pikin dɛn we nid ɛlp ɔl ɔba Siera Lyon — de gi dɛn ɛdyukeshɔn, gud it, mɛdikal kia, ɛn di wamnes fɔ man in rɛspɛkt.

core.heading2: Chɛnj We De Mek Big Difrɛns

s.title: Gud It & Fiding

core.p7desc: Wi de fɛn big big talent insay Siera Lyon in kɔmyuniti dɛn — futbɔl, myuzik, at, skul wok — ɛn de bil rod fɔ dɛn go di wɔl steyj.

about: Bɔt Pandie Fɔndeshɔn
Mama fɔ Ɔl
Wan yumanitɛrian nɔnprɔfit we dɛn dɛdikeyt fɔ protɛkt ɛn ɛp fɔ mek dɛn go bifo
pikin dɛn we nɔ gɛt pawa na Siera Lion bay we dɛn de gi dɛn ɛdyukeshɔn, gud it,
mɛdikal ɛp, ɛn kɛa we gɛt sɔri at.
Wi Impakt
Ɛvri Nɔmba Na Pikin We Layf Dɔn Chenj
Pikin Dɛn We Dɛn Dɔn Sɔpɔt
ɛn de go bifo
Prɔgrɛm Dɛn We De Wɔk
ɔlsay na Siera Lion
Kɔntri Dɛn We Dɛn Dɔn Rich
Yusa ɛn Siera Lion
Dɔneshɔn Transparɛnsi
ɛvri sɛnt dɛn dɔn kɔnt fɔ am
"Wi mishɔn simpul bɔt i impɔtant kwik kwik wan:
fɔ mek shɔ se nɔ pikin nɔ go lɔs chans fɔ gro, lan, ɛn go bifo
jɔs bikɔs dɛn bɔn dɛn insay hadship."
Dis na di bilif we bɔn Pandie Fɔndeshɔn — ɛn di prɔmis we de mek ɔl wetin wi de du de go bifo.
Fɔndeshɔn Fɔnda
Fɔnda ɛn Ɛgzekyutiv Dayrɛktɔ
Siera Lion — Yunayted Stets
Wan Mɛsej Frɔm di Fɔnda
Mi Stat Dis Fɔndeshɔn Bikɔs Mi Si di Sɔfrin Wit Mi Yon Ay
Wɛl mi de gro na Siera Lion, mi si pikin dɛn we ful-ɔf intɛlijɛns, krietiviti,
ɛn drim dɛm — we nɔ gɛt rod fɔ go bifo jɔs bikɔs dɛn pɔ.
A si famili dɛm we bin lɛf dɛn pikin dɛm dip wan
bɔt nɔ bin ebul fɔ pe skul fis, mɛdsin, ɔ ivin it.
A bin kɛr dɛn fes dɛm wit mi as A de bil mi layf.
Wɛn A bin set Pandie Foundation, A bin gi am nem afta mi mami,
Pandie Grace Bangura — wan uman we bin gi ɔl wetin i gɛt
to ɛnibɔdi we nid am, plɛnti tɛm bifo i tek kɛr fɔ insɛf.
I bin tich mi se kɔmpashɔn nɔ gɛt limit,
ɛn se mami lɛf fɔ rich ɔl pikin we nid am.
Dis fɔndeshɔn na mi prɔmis to am — ɛn to ɔl pikin dɛm na Sierra Leone
we dizɔf di sem chans we dɛn bin gi mi.
A gɛt tanga to ɔl dɔnɔ, vɔlɔntia, ɛn patna
we dɛn pik fɔ stan wit wi na dis mishɔn.
— Fawnda & Ɛgzɛkyutiv Dairɛkta
Fɔ Onɔ
Di hat ɛn di sol we de bihayn dis fɔndeshɔn
Di Nem we De Bihayn di Fɔndeshɔn
Pikin man in Onɔ fɔ In Mami in Lɛf we Nɔ De Ɛn
Pandie Grace Bangura nɔ jɔs bi mami fɔ in yon pikin dɛm nɔmɔ.
I na mami fɔ ɔlman we de rawnd am.
Na wan kɔmyuniti we plɛnti pipul nɔ gɛt plɛnti tin, i de gi fri wan —
in tɛm, in it, in wamnes, in strɛnt, ɛn in kɔmpashɔn.
I si ɔngri pikin ɛn i gi dɛn it.
I nɔ ɛva aks wetin i go gɛt bak.
In layf we ful-ap wit kɛr ɛn gi-gi bin mek dɛn gi di nem Pandie,
we min "Di Mami fɔ Ɔl."
Dɛn bin mek dis fɔndeshɔn fɔ in onɔ ɛn i de tan lɛk wan tin we de kɔntinyu
fɔ di kɔmpashɔn we i de sho ɛvri de,
we de mek in lɛf rich ɔl pikin we nid am.
"I bin biliv se ɔl pikin impɔtant — nɔ jɔs in yon dɛm nɔmɔ — ɛn se tru kaynnes dɛn de mɛzɔ bay aw wi de kɛr fɔ dɛn we nɔ gɛt plɛnti tin."
— Joseph Allan Kamara, Fawnda
Wi Jɔni
Frɔm wan Drim to wan Muvmɛnt
Di Biginin
Wan Vishɔn Bɔn
Joseph Allan Kamara, we bɔn na Sierra Leone, de si di strɔgul dɛm fɔ pikin dɛm we nɔ gɛt sɔpɔt ɛn i gɛt wan dip bilif se sɔntin fɔ du.
Di Inspireshɔn
Dɛn Gi Nem Afta Mami
Dɛn gi di fɔndeshɔn nem fɔ onɔ Pandie Grace Bangura — wan uman we in lɛf we nɔ de tink bɔt insɛf ɛn in kɔmpashɔn fɔ ɔda pipul de kɔntinyu fɔ mek di sol fɔ dis mishɔn.
Di Fɔndeshɔn
Dɛn Set Pandie Foundation
Dɛn ɔfishali set Pandie Foundation as wan yumanitɛrian nɔn-prɔfit ɔganizeshɔn we de wok fɔ sɔpɔt pikin dɛm we nɔ gɛt sɔpɔt na Sierra Leone tru ɛdyukeshɔn, nyutrishɔn, ɛn mɛdikal kɛr.
Di Prɔgram Dɛm
Dɛn Lan Six Kɔ Prɔgram Dɛm
Ɛdyukeshɔn Sɔpɔt, Nyutrishɔn Sɔpɔt, Mɛdikal Asistans, Pikin Protekshɔn, Pikin Spɔnsɔship, ɛn Kɔmyuniti Autrich prɔgram dɛm dɛn divɛlɔp ɛn stat fɔ wok.
Di Fyuchɔ
De Gro fɔ Gɛt Big Impakt
Wit di sɔpɔt frɔm dɔnɔ dɛm, vɔlɔntia dɛm, ɛn patna dɛm ɔlsay na di wɔl, Pandie Foundation de ɛkspand in rich ɛn de bil fɔ wan fyuchɔ we nɔ pikin nɔ go lef bihayn.
Di Rɛyaliti we Wi De Fes
Bihayn ɛvri Statistik Na Pikin we Gɛt Nem
Insai bɔku kɔmyuniti dɛn na Sierra Leone, pikin dɛn de mit chalenj dɛn
we de trɛtin dɛn fyuja frɔm di bɛri biginin.
Dɛn nɔto prɔblɛm dɛn we de fawe — dɛn de apin naw naw,
to tru pikin dɛn wit tru drim dɛn.
Wan Pikin We Want Fɔ Lan
I de wek bifo sɔn kɔmɔt ɛn de waka mayl dɛn go skul,
jɔs fɔ sidɔm insai klasrum we nɔ gɛt tɛksbuk dɛn,
we nɔ gɛt garanti se i go ebul kɔm bak tumɔro
if in famili nɔ ebul pe di fi dɛn.
Wan Pikin We De Go Slip Hɔngri
I nayn ia ol ɛn i dɔn sabi ɔlrɛdi
aw i de fil fɔ kɔnsintrɛt wit hɔngri.
Sɔm dez, di ɔnli tin we de bitwin am ɛn ɛmti bɛlɛ
na wan kɔp rayz nɔmɔ.
Wan Pikin We Nid Mɛdikal Kea
I dɔn gɛt fiva fɔ wan wik.
In mami sabi wetin fɔ du bɔt i nɔ ebul fɔ bɔy di mɛdisin.
I de pre ɛn wach ɛn wet —
bikɔs di ɔltanativ nɔto tin we pɔsin go tink bɔt.
Dɛn nɔto statistik dɛn we de fawe. Dɛn na tru pikin dɛn wit tru drim dɛn.
Dɛn fyuja de dipɛnd pan if sɔm pɔsin — sɔmwe — go chuz fɔ kea.
Pandie Foundation de fɔ bi da pɔsin de.
Wi Mishɔn
Fɔ mek shɔ se nɔ pikin nɔ go lɔs di chans fɔ gro, lan,
ɛn de du fayn jɔs bikɔs dɛn bɔn dɛn insai hadship.
Wi de gi ɛdyukeshɔn, gud it, mɛdikal kea, ɛn prɔtɛkshɔn —
de trit ɛvri pikin as if na wi pikin dɛn.
Wi Vishɔn
Wan Sierra Leone — ɛn ivinchuali wan Afrika —
we nɔ pikin nɔ go fɔgɛt, nɔ pikin nɔ go fɔs fɔ lɛf ɛdyukeshɔn,
ɛn ɛvri pikin go gro big sabi se dɛn layf impɔtant
ɛn dɛn fyuja wɛt fɔ fɛt fɔ.
Wetin Wi De Du
Siks We Dɛn Wi De Chanj Pikin Fyuja
Wi de fɔkɔs pan di impɔtant nid dɛn we de mek pikin nɔ jɔs sɔvayv bɔt fɔ du fayn.
Ɛvri prɔgram we wi de dizayn de gayd bay wan prinsipul: trit ɛvri pikin as if na wi pikin dɛn.
Ɛdyukeshɔn Sɔpɔt
Skul fi dɛn, sɔplay dɛn, yunifɔm dɛn, ɛn matirial dɛn so dat nɔ pikin nɔ go mis lanin.
Gud It & It
Gud it dɛn ɛn it ɛlp so dat hɔngri nɔ go ɛva kɔm bitwin pikin ɛn dɛn fyuja.
Mɛdikal Kea
Hɛltkea ɛn mɛdikal sɔpɔt fɔ pikin dɛn we de sɔfa frɔm sik dɛn we yu ebul prevɛnt ɛn trit.
Pikin Prɔtɛkshɔn
Advokasi, sefti, ɛn digniti prɔgram dɛn fɔ pikin dɛn we de pan denja fɔ nɛglɛkt ɛn ɛksplɔyteshɔn.
Pikin Spɔnsɔship
Lɔng-tɛm indivijul spɔnsɔship we de kɔnɛkt jɛnɛrɔs dɔnɔ dɛn strɛt wit pikin jɔni.
Kɔmyuniti Rich-awt
De wok an-in-an wit famili dɛn, lokal lida dɛn, ɛn skul dɛn fɔ mek chanj we go de fɔ lɔng tɛm.
Lɛ Wi Luk Ɔl Prɔgram Dɛn
Wi Valyu Dɛn
Wetin De Gayd Ɔl Wetin Wi De Du
Intɛgriti
Transparɛnt ɛn akawntabul insai ɔl tin — ɛvri risɔs yuz rɛspɔnsibul ɛn wit pɔpɔs.
Kɔmpashɔn
Ɛvri disishɔn we dɛn mek wit di wɛlbiiŋ fɔ pikin dɛn ɛn famili dɛn we dɛn put insaid di senta tru tru.
Rɛspɛkt
Fɔ ɔnɔ di diginiti fɔ ɛvri pikin, ɛvri famili, ɛn ɛvri kɔmyuniti we wi gɛt di chans fɔ sɔv.
Impakt
Wi dɛn kɔmit fɔ chenj we go de fɔ lɔŋ tɛm ɛn we go kɔntinyu — nɔto jɔs smɔl riliif fɔ smɔl tɛm, bɔt fyucha dɛn we dɛn dɔn chenj.
Yu go ansa di kɔl?
Sɔmwe na Siera Lion tide nɛt, wan pikin de wet fɔ op.
Sɔpɔta dɛn, patna dɛn, ɛn dɔnɔ dɛn de bɔn pat fɔ wan famili we de ɔlsay na di wɔl
we dɛn kɔmit fɔ protɛkt pikin dɛn ɛn fɔ pul op bak us place i dɔn lɔs.
Ɛvri tin we yu gi de ɛlp fɔ gi skul tin dɛn, it dɛn, mɛdikal tritment,
ɛn wan sef invairɔnmɛnt fɔ pikin dɛn fɔ gro wit kɔnfidɛns ɛn diginiti.
Wɛn yu sɔpɔt Pandie Foundation, yu nɔto jɔs de gi mɔni.
Yu de tek di rol we Pandie Grace Bangura
de kɔntinyu fɔ bi ɛvri wan de —
wan protɛkta, wan provayda, ɛn wan sɔs fɔ op we nɔ de shek.
Dɔnet naw — Chenj layf.
Kɔm Jɔyn Wi
“Pandie Foundation — Di Mɔda fɔ Ɔl — i de fɔ kɔmpashɔn we nɔ gɛt bɔnda ɛn op we nɔ gɛt limit.”
stories: Dɛn nɔto statistik dɛn. Dɛn na pikin dɛn we gɛt nem, vɔys, drim dɛn — ɛn fyucha dɛn we dɛn chenj bikɔs sɔmbɔdi pik fɔ kia.
“A want fɔ bi ticha wan de.”

Aminata bin lɛk skul, bɔt in mɔda bin de strɔgul fɔ gɛt buk dɛn, skul tin dɛn, ɛn di tin dɛn we dɛn nid ɛvri de. Sɔm de dɛn i bin de go klas wit wari se i go nid fɔ stɔp. Trow Pandie Foundation, i gɛt skul tin dɛn, sɔpɔt, ɛn di kɔnfidɛns fɔ kɔntinyu. Tide i de sidɔm na klas wit nyu op — ɛn wan drim.
A want fɔ bi ticha wan de.
Aminata bin lɛk skul bɔt in mɔda nɔ bin ebul fɔ gɛt skul tin dɛn. Wit Pandie in sɔpɔt, i gɛt buk dɛn, yunifɔm dɛn, ɛn nyu kɔnfidɛns fɔ kɔntinyu.
Naw a kin tink klin na klas.
Musa bin de kam skul ɔngri ɛvri de. Di fid program gi am it dɛn ɛvri de ɛn chenj in ebuliti fɔ kɔnsɛntret ɛn lan.
A bin res mi an na klas fɔ di fɔs tɛm.
Hawa bin gɛt maynd bɔt i nɔ bin gɛt tin dɛn. Buk dɛn, skul tin dɛn, ɛn ɛnkɔrejment frɔm Pandie gi am di kɔnfidɛns fɔ tek pat ful wan.
Wan sik we dɛn bin fɔ dɔn prevɛnt bin kip Mariama na os fɔ wik dɛn. Mɛdikal ɛsistans trow Pandie mek dɛn trit am ɛn i kam bak na klas.
Ibrahim bin de gɛt neglɛkt na os. Di protɛkshɔn program gi am sefti, sɔpɔt, ɛn big pɔsin dɛn we bin de kam fɔ am ɔltɛm.
A gɛt wetin a nid naw.
Bɛsik skul tin dɛn — skul bag, pɛnsul dɛn, yunifɔm — chenj aw Kadiatu bin de fil wɛn i de waka go skul ɛvri wan mɔnin.
Yu dɔneshɔn de rayt di nɛks chapta fɔ wan pikin na Siera Lion.
events: Ɛvri ivɛnt na strɛt kɛa — we dɛn de bring it it, ɛdyukeshɔn, mɛdikal hɛlp, ɛn hop to pikin dɛn we nid am pas ɔl.
Skul bag dɛn ɛn buk dɛn
Hɔt mil dɛn we dɛn de sav
Ɔl Ivɛnt Dɛn We De Kam
Mek patna wit wi ɛn put yu brand bihayn wan mishɔn we impɔtant. Kɔprɛt spɔnsɔ dɛn de gɛt rɛkɔgnishɔn, ripɔtin, ɛn dɛn de no se dɛn sapɔt rich tru pikin dɛn.
contact: Wi go gladi fɔ yɛri frɔm yu
If yu want fɔ dɔnet, mek patna, vɔlɔntia, ɔ jɔs fɔ lan mɔ — wi de ya ɛn wi go gladi fɔ kɔnɛkt.
Wi de ansa ɛvri mɛsɛj pɛsɔnali.
Wi tim de luk ɛvri kwɛshɔn. Ɛkspɛkt ansa insay 1–2 biznɛs dez.
Tɛnki fɔ yu rich aut. Wi go rɛspɔn insaid 1–2 wokin dez.
Tɛl wi aw yu want fɔ ɛlp ɔ wetin yu want fɔ no...
Duya, enta wan valɛd imel adrɛs.
Sɔntin nɔ bin go rayt. Duya, tray bak.
getInvolved: Ɛvri pɛsin we jɔyn dis mishɔn — as dɔna, vɔlɔntia, patna, ɔ advoket — de bɛkɔm pat pan wan famili we nɔ de tɔn bɔku pan pikin we nid ɛlp.
Giv mɔni — wan tɛm ɔ ɛvri mɔnt — ɛn direk fɔnd ɛdyukeshɔn, it, mɛdikal kia, ɛn prɔtɛkshɔn fɔ pikin dɛm na Sierra Leone.
Kɔmit to wan pikin jɔni. Yu mɔntli sɔpɔt de provayd stɛbiliti, digniti, ɛn wan fyucha we dɛm go biliv in.
Kɔmpini dɛm ɛn ɔganizeshɔn dɛm go kɔn patna wit Pandie Foundation fɔ CSR kampen dɛm, ko-brand ivɛnt dɛm, ɛn impakt ripɔtin.
Ɔfa yu tɛm, skil dɛm, ɔ prɔfɛshɔnal ɛkspɛrtiz — frɔm fɔr ɔ fes-to-fes — fɔ strɛntin wi mishɔn ɛn wok dɛm.
Sheb wi mishɔn pan soshial midia, wit yu kɔmyuniti, ɔ wit yu ɛmplɔya. Awɛnɛs de mek dɔna dɛm ɛn dɔna dɛm de sev layf dɛm.
Alayn yu brand wit wan koz we impɔtant. Ɛmplɔyi givin prɔgram dɛm, machin gift dɛm, ɛn spɔnsɔship dɛm ɔl wɛlkɔm.
Yu nɔ nid fɔ rich fɔ mek difrɛns. Yu jɔs nid fɔ kɛa. Ɛnitin we yu go ebul gi — tɛm, mɔni, vɔys, ɔ skil — i impɔtant pas we yu sabi.
donate: Se yu kam ya — rɛdi fɔ gi — dɔn min plɛnti pas we yu go ebul tink fɔ wi. Wi ɔnlayn dɔneshɔn pej de bil am naw fɔ mek shɔ se ɛvri gift rich pikin sef ɛn sikyur.
Ɔnlayn fɔ gi go ɔpen kwik kwik wan. Te dat tɛm, if yu at de lid yu fɔ ɛlp pikin tide, wi go gladi pasmak fɔ yɛri frɔm yu stret.
Tɛl wi aw yu want fɔ ɛlp — wan tɛm gift, mɔntli spɔnsɔship, ɔ spɔnsɔ wan spɛshal pikin — ɛn wi tim go pɛsinɛli gayd yu tru am.
“Ɛvri pikin we dɛn rich, ɛvri mil we dɛn gi, ɛvri layf we dɛn ɛlp — ɔl dat de stat wit wan at lɛk yu yon we pik fɔ kɛa.”

footer.mission: Wi na chariti ɔganayzeshɔn we nɔ de wok fɔ prɔfit, we gi insɛf fɔ protɛkt ɛn ɛp di pikin dɛn we de sɔfa na Sierra Leone tru ɛdyukeshɔn, gud it, mɛdikal ɛp ɛn kia we ful wit lɛk.
